descriptions.description_a: Coils of heavy rope and barrels of pitch crowd the walls of this compact storeroom.
descriptions.description_b: An anchor brand stamps every crate and barrel here.

descriptions.description_a: The candles here burn low, casting everything in deep shadow. Goods
descriptions.description_b: are displayed behind a low iron barrier. The skull crest pressed in
descriptions.description_c: jet wax warns that only hall members are welcome here.

descriptions.description_a: Built like a proper shop with iron-banded shelves and a stone counter
descriptions.description_b: worn smooth by countless trades. The fortress gate emblem stamped in
descriptions.description_c: blue wax marks each price tag.

descriptions.description_a: Reserved for the hall's inner circle, this gilt-edged provision room
descriptions.description_b: stocks the finest goods in the building. A crown embossed in gold wax
descriptions.description_c: marks each item as hall property.

descriptions.description_a: Pristine white marble shelving and crystal display cases make this
descriptions.description_b: inner vault feel more like a treasury than a shop. The diamond star
descriptions.description_c: crest shimmers faintly on the back wall.

descriptions.description_a: Military-grade racks of weapons and stacked armor plates fill this
descriptions.description_b: inner depot. Everything is numbered, logged, and accounted for --
descriptions.description_c: this hall runs a tight operation.

descriptions.description_a: Heavy ironwood shelving bolted floor to ceiling holds a solid stock.
descriptions.description_b: The carved tree crest on the back wall is worn smooth from members
descriptions.description_c: running their hands across it for luck.

descriptions.description_a: Solid ironwood crates and locked chests fill most of this back supply room.
descriptions.description_b: A carved tree sigil marks the stock as hall property. The atmosphere is
descriptions.description_c: unhurried -- this hall does not need to rush its business.

descriptions.description_a: Neat rows of arms and armor line the shelves of this inner storeroom.
descriptions.description_b: A bright yellow wax leaf insignia pressed above the rack identifies
descriptions.description_c: its keeper.

descriptions.description_a: A vaulted stone hall with polished marble counters and rows of sealed scrolls
descriptions.description_b: The sharp scent of fresh parchment and sealing wax fills the air. Brass plaques on the wall list the deed tiers and their capacities. A stern-faced clerk waits behind the counter.
descriptions.description_c: Welcome to the Realm Deed Office. Here you may purchase a deed to establish your gang's hall. Choose wisely â€” the tier of your deed determines the size of your domain.

descriptions.description_a: A dim, narrow storeroom stacked with stolen goods and rough surplus.
descriptions.description_b: Crates are marked with a crude skull scratched in red chalk. The shelf
descriptions.description_c: keeper barely looks up when you enter.

descriptions.description_a: A cramped room with weapon racks and surplus gear heaped in unlabeled crates.
descriptions.description_b: A skull burned into the doorframe marks it as belonging to the hall.
descriptions.description_c: The vendor eyes you with quiet suspicion.

descriptions.description_a: A windowless room with black-lacquered shelves and silver-inked labels
descriptions.description_b: on every item. The vendor speaks in a whisper and slides goods across
descriptions.description_c: the counter without meeting your eyes.

descriptions.description_a: Polished silver fixtures and velvet drapes give this spacious emporium
descriptions.description_b: the air of a nobleman's merchant house. The horse-head crest etched in
descriptions.description_c: every shelf edge gleams under bright lanterns.

descriptions.description_a: Quality provisions are arranged in this well-kept inner outfitters.
descriptions.description_b: A rearing horse silhouette embossed in silver adorns the leather
descriptions.description_c: goods lining the walls.

descriptions.description_a: The weapon racks here hold finer steel than most shops in the city.
descriptions.description_b: Violet-lacquered grips and scabbards hang in careful rows; the hall
descriptions.description_c: takes pride in the quality of its arms.

descriptions.description_a: A roomy trading post with marked shelves and a heavy plank counter.
descriptions.description_b: The anchor and rope crest of the hall is carved above the doorway,
descriptions.description_c: lending the place a rough merchant's pride.

descriptions.description_a: Gilded display cases hold some of the finest merchandise in the realm.
descriptions.description_b: The hall's crown crest worked in gold leaf adorns the arched entrance,
descriptions.description_c: a mark of standing that every transaction here reinforces.

descriptions.description_a: The grandest hall shop in the realm. Its vaulted ceiling and luminous
descriptions.description_b: white stone walls lend a cathedral-like gravity to every transaction.
descriptions.description_c: Nothing here comes cheap.

descriptions.description_a: Polished display cases and velvet-lined trays set this exchange apart
descriptions.description_b: from lesser hall shops. The crossed-swords crest gleams in silver
descriptions.description_c: above the heavy oak counter.

descriptions.description_a: Clean shelving and organized stock give this hall shop a tidy,
descriptions.description_b: guild-like air. Bright yellow lacquer along the counter edge marks it
descriptions.description_c: as the official trade room of the hall.
